actions.script: if (System.getProperty('purchase.pricing.qa.disposable') != 'true' || !(ec.user.username in ['purchase.pricing.qa','purchase.pricing.viewer'])) { ec.web.response.setStatus(403); ec.web.sendJsonResponse([denied:true]); return } def calls = [ createPo:'zenith.purchase.OperationsServices.create#PurchaseOrder', addPoLine:'zenith.purchase.OperationsServices.add#PurchaseOrderLine', updatePo:'zenith.purchase.OperationsServices.update#PurchaseOrder', create:'zenith.purchase.OperationsServices.create#GoodsReceiptNote', get:'zenith.purchase.GoodsReceiptServices.get#GoodsReceipt', details:'zenith.purchase.GoodsReceiptServices.save#GoodsReceiptDetails', line:'zenith.purchase.GoodsReceiptServices.save#GoodsReceiptLine', submit:'zenith.purchase.GoodsReceiptServices.submit#GoodsReceipt', cancel:'zenith.purchase.GoodsReceiptServices.cancel#GoodsReceipt', receive:'zenith.inventory.ReceiptServices.receive#Stock', reserved:'zenith.inventory.ReceiptServices.get#PendingGrnQuantities', received:'zenith.inventory.ReceiptServices.get#OrderReceiptQuantities' ] def name = calls[ec.web.parameters.op] if (!name) { ec.web.response.setStatus(400); ec.web.sendJsonResponse([denied:true]); return } def values = [:] ['orderId','orderItemSeqId','vendorPartyId','organizationPartyId','productId','itemDescription','quantity','unitAmount', 'purchaseOrderId','receiptDate','grnId','facilityId','invoiceId','vendorInvoiceNumber','plannedQuantity','grnReceivedBefore', 'quantityAccepted','valuationRate','batchNumber','manufacturingDate','expiryDate','statusId'].each { key -> if (ec.web.parameters.containsKey(key)) values[key] = ec.web.parameters[key] } if (values.statusId) { values.updates = [statusId:values.remove('statusId')] } ec.message.clearErrors() def result = ec.service.sync().name(name).parameters(values).call() def errors = ec.message.hasError() ? [ec.message.getErrorsString()] : [] ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse([result:result,errors:errors])
